author: pep-react-lab-replacement author lane (Claude Opus 5.5)
decidedBy: pep-react-lab-replacement-reconciler loop 8 (Claude Opus 5.5, fresh independent context; neither the lab author, either critic, nor any earlier reconciler), applying firstmate decision inbox 019

decisions.rationale: Status changed in loop 8: the loop-8 education and SME rechecks mark it resolved. Loop 7 decided reject-with-evidence before Firstmate's later ruling; this decision supersedes that one. Decided: Firstmate decision inbox 019 (2026-11-18) confirmed that the acceptance sentence in inbox 018 governs (a load-failing learner test is an unreadable form and must receive the existing general safe unreadable message, without printing the suite error) and authorized the smallest correction in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs only. Implemented at commit 2cb3e0d1; the diff 284d8903..2cb3e0d1 under react/forms-context-and-crud touches only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs and the module lock. It hoists the general unreadable-form message into one constant with byte-identical text, adds one branch after the unchanged no-runnable branch and before the unchanged-copy branch that pushes that constant when the control report has a failed test file and no passed and no failed assertions, and makes the existing variant-run unshift use the same constant. The verifier's sha256 is now 8ac7c6253facc38427a6f5229cab846ae38f8b80be81d7d86c771e53bbc5c6e1; lab.json, task8-variant.jsx (d85eae98...), t2-labels.test.jsx and the README are unchanged, so the recorded v1 and v3 lows are preserved. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 2cb3e0d1 (2cb3e0d1a7057d24d12a8f87d1d16467a997b891), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. The reference test was accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. Load-failure guard used in the learner-side probes: a module-level check, derived from the reference test, that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export's source text contains a hook name used only by the Task 8 variant wrapper, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the check. (A) Learner-side load failure, guard added to the single README-named test file: normal run 'Test Files 8 passed (8)' and 'Tests 8 passed (8)', then npm test printed exactly one Task 8 line, the general unreadable-form message, exit 1. (B) Harness-side load failure, a module-level throw with a second marker string appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards, sha256 d85eae98... rechecked): normal run 8 of 8, then the same single unreadable-form line, exit 1. Neither marker string, nor 'Vitest said', nor the unchanged-copy or no-runnable message appeared in A or B, so the suite error is not exposed. (E) A deleted learner test file ('Test Files 7 passed (7)') still got only the no-runnable message, exit 1. The todo-only, skip-only, beforeAll-hook, real-failed-assertion control, blank-only, name-only and outside-form caption cases, and the 284d8903 verifier swap for A and B, are critic-reported and were not rerun by the reconciler. The claim is resolved for a control report whose only test file fails to load, which is the single-file layout README task 8 describes. A load failure in a report that also holds a passing assertion from another learner test file is not covered by the new condition; that gap is decided under edu-fcc-y1 / sme-fcc-y1 and does not reopen this finding. Consolidated with sme-fcc-x1.

Claim verified true; consolidated across edu-fcc-y1 and sme-fcc-y1, which describe the same behaviour from the learner and technical sides. Cause, confirmed from the code: runVariant computes fileFailed, failed and passed across every test file the mutation config includes (../starter/src/**/*.test.jsx), so the new branch fires only when the whole control report has zero passed assertions. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 2cb3e0d1 (2cb3e0d1a7057d24d12a8f87d1d16467a997b891), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. The reference test was accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. Load-failure guard used in the learner-side probes: a module-level check, derived from the reference test, that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export's source text contains a hook name used only by the Task 8 variant wrapper, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the check. (C) Critics' case, reconciler-rerun: the reference test kept unchanged plus a second learner test file holding the guard and one trivial passing test. Normal run 'Test Files 9 passed (9)' and 'Tests 9 passed (9)'; npm test printed only the unchanged-copy message, exit 1, and no marker string. The control variant run directly exited 1 with a report of numTotalTestSuites 2, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 1, numPassedTests 1: the extra file failed with no assertion results and the reference file passed one assertion. With the 284d8903 verifier (sha256 6fe16b97...) swapped into scratch the same probe printed the same unchanged-copy message, exit 1. (G) Reconciler-found case beyond the critics' probe, and the more realistic one: the README-named starter/src/service-form.test.jsx is itself the file that fails to load. Harness-side module-level throw appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards, sha256 d85eae98... rechecked), the reference test unchanged, plus a second learner test file that does not import the form and holds one trivial passing test. Normal run 9 of 9; npm test printed only the unchanged-copy message, exit 1, no marker string. Control report: numTotalTestSuites 2, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 1, numPassedTests 1, with service-form.test.jsx status failed and no assertion results and the other file passed. Under the 284d8903 verifier G got the same unchanged-copy message, exit 1. So neither C nor G is a regression from 284d8903, and both are learner-safe: exit 1, no weak test is accepted, the suite error is hidden and no solution code is revealed. Severity low, agreed. Decision: escalate, non-blocking. Reasons. (1) Inbox 019 says the observable requirement governs over the one-condition implementation wording: a load-failing learner test is an unreadable form and must receive the existing general safe unreadable message. Neither inbox 018 nor inbox 019 scopes that requirement to a control report holding a single test file, and 019's own instruction ('route a failed control file with zero passed or failed assertions') reads at least as naturally per file as report-wide. In G the README-named learner test fails to load and still gets the unchanged-copy message, which tells a learner with a correct test that it depends on something other than the form; the observable requirement is therefore unmet in the multi-file layout. (2) A byte change is warranted to meet that requirement fully, and it needs a new Firstmate decision because 019 authorized only the condition now implemented. Smallest change, recommended: in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs only, have runVariant also report whether any failed test file has no assertion results, and use that, together with no failed assertion anywhere in the report, as the new branch's condition instead of the report-wide zero passed count; keep the no-runnable branch, the unchanged-copy branch for any real failed assertion, every message text and the suite-error suppression unchanged, and add C and G to the private adversarial controls. (3) Alternative Firstmate may choose instead: accept C and G as a recorded v1 residual with no byte change, as both critics recommend, on the grounds that README task 8 names one test file and the realistic trigger in G (a harness-side load failure) has not been observed on macOS and Windows and Linux are unverified. Either choice is non-blocking for this lab; this record does not start a correction loop and claims no Firstmate confirmation.
